candidates.name: 농묵 · 묵직한 장단
candidates.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: second-round Korean title logo concept for Joseon Hunters, a dark fantasy action RPG with Korean hip-hop / fusion gugak swagger.
Input image 1 role: STYLE REFERENCE, the user-selected direction. Take its broad ONE-LINE Korean brush wordmark, vigorous forward energy, thick confident strokes, subtly syncopated rhythm, long low flourish and tiny vermilion seal. Create a new related concept, not an unrelated redesign. No metal, no geometric sans, no two-line lockup.
Text (verbatim): "조선헌터스". EXACTLY FIVE Hangul syllable blocks: 조 / 선 / 헌 / 터 / 스. Correct clean Hangul anatomy is essential. Keep ㅎ and its counter in 헌, ㄴ batchim in 헌 and 선, ㅌ in 터 and the ㅅ branches legible. No alternate spelling or secondary text.
Primary request: evolve reference 1 into an exceptional Korean ink-brush logo that makes the physical behavior of ink a beautiful graphic signature. Restrained Korean hip-hop confidence and fusion-gugak strong/weak rhythm through lettering. Serious dark-fantasy title identity.
Composition/framing: polished landscape 3:2 presentation, one large single-line centered logo roughly 82% image width, comfortable margins, no cropped strokes, no title labels or explanatory captions. Extremely subtle paper texture. One tiny textless vermilion seal at the right end only.
Constraints: preserve immediately readable five-syllable title. Ink flourishes and texture must never obscure the letters. The lettering remains the subject; no character, scenery, instruments, microphones, headphones, fashion accessories, sword pictures, dragons, fire, smoke illustration, graffiti tags, UI, mockup, watermark, or extra symbols.
Direction: Switch the presentation to clean warm off-white hanji paper so REAL BLACK INK is visible. The title is intensely black, heavy, wet Korean calligraphy. Broad thick strokes with rich pooled carbon-black ink at starts and crossings, luxurious organic black-to-slate variation within the ink, rounded pressure transitions leading into fast sharp tapered exits. Strong low rising baseline, short syncopated differences in syllable height. A single black broad but controlled underline accelerates at its tip. Full dark wet strokes, a few subtle pooling rims, minimal texture loss, very little splatter. Readable open counters and distinct syllable spacing even with this weight. Keep the swagger and almost-horizontal silhouette of the reference. Restrained, powerful ink presence.
